extraction_notes: Output and transfer curves were digitized from the supplied PDF plots without inventing or interpolating points. P-channel curve coordinates are recorded as positive magnitudes while the original axes and polarity are cited in each curve's test conditions.
No capacitance-versus-VDS figure is present. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are transcribed from the table at |VDS| = 16 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz.

The RDS(on) table values are 450 mOhm minimum and 520 mOhm typical at |VGS| = 4.5 V, 650 mOhm minimum and 780 mOhm typical at |VGS| = 2.5 V, and 950 mOhm maximum at |VGS| = 1.8 V. The strict schema records the available typical values and the 1.8 V maximum.

The datasheet publishes IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = -20 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum +/-20 uA at VGS = +/-10 V and VDS = 0 V, gFS typical 1.2 S at VDS = -10 V and ID = -0.54 A, and switching timing values; these fields are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
No body-diode reverse-recovery time or reverse-recovery charge is published in the supplied datasheet.
The thermal maximum is RthetaJA = 1250 degC/W on the stated FR4 mounting condition; thermal fields are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
